as_told.title: Taylor works for the Hammer, who works for God

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor is said to have told people that he works for someone called "the Hammer", and no one knows who that is. Chris Bledsoe, a man whom NASA has studied because UFOs are said to appear around him, tells Michels that Taylor said to him, around 2008 to 2011, "I work for the hammer and the hammer works for God," and Bledsoe links it to the film The Adjustment Bureau and the story it came from, The Adjustment Team, in which hidden agents quietly steer people's lives. Bob McGwier, a former CIA contractor, repeats the same account as he heard it from Bledsoe, adding that "no one that I know knows who the hammer is."
